landing.slide1Kicker: For international schools and academic centers
landing.slide1Title: Academic operations, built to a higher standard
landing.slide1Body: One platform for booking, attendance, content, and reviews — instead of WhatsApp threads and notebooks.
landing.slide2Title: Choosing a teacher should feel considered
landing.slide2Body: A public directory with clear profiles and reviews after real lessons. Booking happens there — not on the homepage.
landing.slide3Body: Lessons, groups, attendance, and a booking link you send to parents in a second — from one workspace.
landing.featuresTitle: An operating system for serious schools and centers
landing.featuresLead: Designed for teams who work with international families — a quiet interface, a clear flow, and precise permissions.
landing.f1Body: Public profiles, reviews after a confirmed booking, and seats visible before anyone decides. The marketplace stays off the homepage on purpose.
landing.f2Body: Lessons, groups, attendance, materials, and in-class exams. Everything is recorded and reviewable.
landing.f3Body: Session or monthly pricing on the profile. Bookings land in one teacher inbox.
landing.f4Body: A secure booking link. Ratings appear after the real experience — not as advertising copy.
landing.f5Body: A teacher app and a student app on Android and iOS. Operations do not stop at the browser.
landing.howTitle: From sign-up to the first session
landing.how1Body: Student, parent via the student account, or teacher. Permissions are set from day one.
landing.how2Body: A separate directory: filter by stage and subject, then open a profile before any booking.
landing.how3Body: After confirmation: timetable, materials, attendance, and exams — on the same platform.
landing.marketTitle: Teachers live in the marketplace, not here
landing.marketBody: This page does not list teachers or booking buttons. Open the public directory to browse profiles and book.
landing.q1Text: I stopped hunting teachers on WhatsApp. I read the profile and the rating, then book from the link — as clear as any global platform.
landing.q2Text: Bookings arrive from a public page. Time goes to teaching, not coordinating every parent by hand.
landing.q3Text: I found the right physics teacher, and classwork now lives in one place instead of scattered groups.
landing.q4Text: The platform raised how we work with parents. Everything is documented, and the interface fits international schools.
landing.appsLead: Download from the official stores. Same account, same permissions — no mock screenshots.
landing.teacherAppTitle: Run lessons and bookings from your phone
landing.teacherAppBody: Start a session, mark attendance, and answer bookings outside the center.
landing.studentAppTitle: Book and enter class without the chaos
landing.studentAppBody: Schedule, materials, exams, and a ping when the teacher confirms.
landing.finaleTitle: Ready for a clearer academic operation?
landing.finaleBody: Create an account, or open the marketplace if you already know who you need.
landing.tagline: Learn Without Limits · تعلم بلا حدود
landing.footerAbout: An academic operations platform for schools and centers that need a clear system for booking, attendance, and reviews.
